## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or quantitative mathematical model you are proposing.

## Problem or Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific trading workflow, risk calculation, or market inefficiency? (e.g., "I need an automated Monte Carlo drawdown simulation for position sizing").

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working:
- Mathematical formulas or algorithmic methodology.
- User interface placement (Dashboard, Pipeline Lab, Risk Calculator, Trade Journal, Macro Cycle).
- Data sources or endpoints required.

## Alternative Approaches
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context / References
Add any references, research papers, or UI inspirations here.
